Q8031.reason: Disclosing to protect the wife’s health (beneficence) is being prioritized over the patient’s confidentiality (autonomy).

Q8033.reason: Monocular vision loss with optic-disc pallor and spared eye movements is optic-nerve demyelination (optic neuritis), not MLF or CN III.

Q8034.reason: Cessation of the air leak plus unilateral loss of breath sounds and agitation indicates a malpositioned or nonfunctioning chest tube with recurrent pneumothorax; BP is still stable so the tube should be repositioned.
